name: Jim Haynie
bio: Jim Haynie was born on February 6, 1940 in Falls Church, Virginia, USA. He was an actor, known for The Bridges of Madison County (1995), Country (1984) and The Right Stuff (1983). He was previously married to Maggie Causey and Janice A McKelheer. He died on April 3, 2021 in Langley, Washington, USA.
